statement: Measured facts about arms that this repository cannot execute. Nothing here is signed, none of it grants or requests an exemption by itself; control decides whether to sign, bound to range, entity and verifier per documentation/runbooks/graph-admission-canary-or-exemption.md (A2-455c).
format_note: The runbook defines the signing order but no field schema for the impossibility evidence; this file therefore records the facts a signer needs (path, sha256, class, dependency, required inputs, measured outcome with and without credentials, stub verdict, existing offline coverage). Mapping to the signer input format is control work.

measured_on.redis: local redis-server 7.2.5 built from the upstream tarball for this measurement

impossible_arms.class_meaning: (b) impossible without an externally built native test binary
impossible_arms.external_dependency: no external network service; needs a native test binary built from another repository (Codex http client unit-test artifact)
impossible_arms.what_the_spec_asserts: two tests drive the real Rust native producer over the custody socket; the other tests need an owned PostgreSQL and a socket root
impossible_arms.required_inputs: BENCH_OWNED_NATIVE_TEST_BINARY must name a path containing /clean-native-build-v4/target/debug/deps/codex_http_client- ; BENCH_OWNED_TEST_SOCKET_ROOT
impossible_arms.local_stub_considered: rejected for the native-binary tests: a stand-in binary would fake the producer the tests exist to exercise. The non-native tests are measurable (see measured.owned_store_probe) but the suite plans and reports per file, so the file stays held.

first_messages: Error: explicit owned native UNIT TEST binary required; never invoke Codex
owned_store_probe.note: owned PostgreSQL + private socket root, no native binary: the tests that need the binary fail with "explicit owned native UNIT TEST binary required"

impossible_arms.class_meaning: (b) impossible without a live external service and its credential
impossible_arms.what_the_spec_asserts: real images are generated by fal.ai with a real API key
impossible_arms.local_stub_considered: rejected: live provider response is the assertion. Offline contract is covered by fal-ai.connector.spec.ts.

impossible_arms.class_meaning: (b) impossible without a live external service and its credential
impossible_arms.what_the_spec_asserts: real images are generated by OpenAI with a real API key
impossible_arms.local_stub_considered: rejected: live provider response is the assertion. Offline contract is covered by openai-images.connector.spec.ts.

impossible_arms.class_meaning: (b) impossible without a live external service and its credential
impossible_arms.external_dependency: Google OAuth2 token endpoint (service-account JWT exchange)
impossible_arms.what_the_spec_asserts: a real access token string starting "ya29." is returned by Google
impossible_arms.local_stub_considered: rejected: the assertion is that Google accepts a signed JWT and issues a token; a local stub would only echo a token the test then calls real. The offline JWT-building contract is already covered by vertex-auth.service.spec.ts.

impossible_arms.class_meaning: (b) impossible without a live external service and its credential
impossible_arms.external_dependency: Vertex AI Imagen 4 generation (billed per image)
impossible_arms.what_the_spec_asserts: a real generated image comes back from Imagen and is billed
impossible_arms.local_stub_considered: rejected: the value of the arm is the live provider response and its billing; a stub measures nothing about Imagen. Offline connector behaviour is covered by vertex-image.connector.spec.ts.

impossible_skips_inside_executed_files.class_meaning: (b) impossible without the reviewed Billing3a source snapshot from another repository
impossible_skips_inside_executed_files.effect: maintained-vitest reports skipped=4 and therefore not_measured; the other 3592 tests in that group pass
impossible_skips_inside_executed_files.local_stub_considered: rejected: the spec exists to run the real pinned Journal module; the file states "Absent snapshot is SKIP/NM, never mock success".

not_measured_here_and_not_claimed: hosted-runner behaviour of the container fallback (docker run postgres:16 / redis:7) was not exercised on this host; the hosted root-arms job is the measurement
the R2 arm ran against a local SigV4-verifying S3 contract stub, which says nothing about Cloudflare R2 availability or account configuration

image-router.fallback has one credential-conditional test that returns early without VERTEX_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_JSON; it counts as passed without checking its subject (recorded in the suite row as credential_conditional_tests)

openai-images.connector.integration.spec.ts with RUN_INTEGRATION=1 and no key reports 1 passed + 3 skipped: the one pass does not touch OpenAI and proves nothing about it, so the file is not counted as measured
for the vertex arms, the credential-less run exits 1 because beforeAll throws "VERTEX_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_JSON not set"; the tests are then reported skipped, never passed

on the hosted ci-general runner (PR 205 run 37882496052) maintained-regression reported failed at deploy/compose-network.test.sh ("REFUSED native Compose consumer network contract") under the suite's clean environment, although the same script passes in the lint-and-test step; that row is outside this change and is reported, not fixed or exempted here
